hook: Why does binary search find anything in just 2 steps?

narration.text: Binary search only works on a sorted array.
Check the middle. Index 3 holds 12 — that's less than 23, so the answer is in the right half.
Check the new middle. Index 5 holds 23. Found it.
Two comparisons for seven elements. Every step halves the problem — that's O(log n).

youtube.title: Binary Search in 30 Seconds
youtube.description: How binary search finds a target in a sorted array in O(log n) time — visualized step by step.
